text: Since you're in the neighborhood, you decide to stop by Feslym's house to pay your respects to his widow;  it is a gesture of respect for the Shepherdship and a way of showing your concern for her welfare.  Kira is a tightly-knit community and the tradition of looking after widows and widowers dates back to the earliest days of the colony.  You step onto the porch and open the outer door; to your surprise, {name} opens the inner door, heading outward, at exactly the same moment.  The two of you stare at each other for a second; one must yield the way to the other.  What do you do?

options.title: Wait for and go along with whatever action {name} takes.
results: {name} smiles and steps aside for you.
{name}barges past you without saying a word.

options.title: Demand that {name} step aside.
results: {name} refuses to acknowledge your demand and brushes past you.
{name} tells you to go to hell and pushes you aside.

options.title: Step aside, hold the door open, and say, "After you, {name}!"
results: {name} sneers triumphantly and barges past you.

options.title: Barge past {name}, pushing {him} aside.
results: {name} glares at you and stands {his} ground.
{name} shoves right back and stares you down.
